question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bfd92f62be555962e04c4572a078f766ea554bd66f9e91afd991b55f6c337c2.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

 
• Dark dot is shifting +2, +4, +6, ... inside the circle.
 
• + symbol is shifting +1, +3, +5, ... inside the circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9bf50ad079206415e41699c128f1cc69db1dda10540bad64661489d23330b20.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
